items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Could have been Hubert Clark [phonetic] or someone other. I don’t remember.

ctx.x: How about method books or something? You mentioned a few for a sax that you might have consulted, but . . .

Method books, I don’t know that I had even a trumpet method book at that time, but later I did come across and get the . . . what is it? Can’t even remember the name of it now. Could have been Hubert Clark [phonetic] or someone other. I don’t remember. Arbor [phonetic] or something. I can’t remember the name of the book now, but I think it’s a book that was kind of like the bible for trumpet players. Arbin [phonetic], I think it was.
Do you remember buying your first instrument, your first trumpet, other than the one when you were a kid and worked in the laundry?
